caveat: BiScope supplies original and paraphrased rows. The paraphrased flag is a row property, not a family link: the paraphrased counterpart of a given original text is not identified by the export. Family lineage therefore cannot be recovered from the current dataset; only exact-text grouping is possible. BiScope paraphrased rows are all label=1 in the current build.
In this build every deep_paraphrased row is label=1 and every original row is label=0, so condition and label are perfectly confounded inside this task.
